about: T-509 (row N180). Public security review reports, chosen by a rule fixed before any was read: per firm, the six newest reports in the firm's own public GitHub repository, by the date in the file name. Each source is pinned to the repository commit read on 2026-11-18. The held-out set is every report of one firm (Cyfrin); its list is also in heldout.json. fetch.mjs downloads each file into its own folder under reports/scratch/corpus/ and records its SHA-256 in manifest.json.

rule.pashov: team/md/*_<YYYY-MM-DD>.md, sorted by that date, last 6
